clinvar.name: ClinVar
clinvar.description: Submitted clinical classifications, conditions, review status, and evaluation dates.
clinvar.attribution: ClinVar, National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine. Converted to an indexed local reference format; original assertions retained.

dbsnp.name: dbSNP
dbsnp.description: Reference variant identifiers, assembly-specific alleles, and merged identifiers.
dbsnp.attribution: dbSNP, National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine. Converted to an indexed local reference format.

gnomad.name: gnomAD
gnomad.description: Allele counts, frequencies, ancestry-group frequencies, and source quality filters.
gnomad.attribution: Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD), Broad Institute and contributing studies. Converted to an indexed local reference format. Population frequency is not an individual's ancestry or disease probability.

gwas.name: GWAS Catalog
gwas.description: Published variant–trait associations, reported effect sizes, study populations, and publications.
gwas.license: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use (curated association data)
gwas.attribution: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog. Converted curated associations; study findings are retained as variant context without inferring individual risk.

ensembl.name: Ensembl VEP
ensembl.description: Gene and transcript consequences, protein changes, and source prediction annotations.
ensembl.license: Ensembl data use policy; retain third-party constraints
ensembl.attribution: Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor, EMBL-EBI. Precomputed public reference variants; no user variants are sent to Ensembl.

clinpgx.name: ClinPGx / PharmGKB
clinpgx.description: Curated pharmacogenomic evidence, evidence levels, and drug-response annotations.
clinpgx.attribution: ClinPGx / PharmGKB, Stanford University and contributing curators. Data converted to an indexed reference format; this derived data pack is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. No endorsement is implied.

cpic.name: CPIC
cpic.description: Gene–drug evidence levels and published guideline links where available, without inferring diplotypes or prescribing advice.
cpic.attribution: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium (CPIC), Stanford University and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. Converted gene–drug reference data. Guidelines and content are subject to updates; consult the linked current guideline. No endorsement is implied.
